snippet.title: Path of Exile 2: The Third Edict Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore new acts, face new bosses and resist the Rise of the Abyssal in Path of Exile 2’s new update, the Third Edict!  There are no limits to character leveling, and all progress made during this period will be saved to your account.

The Third Edict releases on August 29 PDT on PC and Consoles

https://pathofexile2.com/edict
